items.text:
suspicious powershell network activity scope outbound powershell connections on monitored devices and correlate them with published behavior and local incident evidence. hf-2025-0001 devicenetworkevents
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where initiatingprocessfilename in~ (
    "powershell.exe",
    "pwsh.exe"
)
| where isnotempty(remoteip)
| project timestamp, devicename, remoteip, remoteport, remoteurl,
          initiatingprocesscommandline
| order by timestamp desc
items.title: Suspicious PowerShell Network Activity

items.text:
gsocket process activity find gsocket tooling in linux endpoint process telemetry for review. hf-2026-0002 deviceprocessevents
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where filename in~ ("gs-netcat", "gsocket", "gsnetcat")
     or processcommandline contains "gs-netcat"
| project timestamp, devicename, accountname, filename, folderpath, processcommandline, initiatingprocessfilename
| order by timestamp desc
items.title: GSocket Process Activity

items.text:
microsoft 365 outage phishing destinations review network or proxy events for the exact downstream domains microsoft reported. hf-2026-0003 customweb_cl
| where timegenerated > ago(7d)
| extend huntdestinationhost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", coalesce(iff(host contains "://", tostring(parse_url(host).host), host), tostring(parse_url(url).host))))
| where huntdestinationhost in ("reallifeaccounting.com", "outagefixed.sbs", "outagerestored.sbs")
| project timegenerated, userprincipal, clientip, remoteip, url, disposition, huntdestinationhost
| order by timegenerated desc
 customweb_cl
| where timegenerated > ago(7d)
| extend huntdestinationhost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", coalesce(iff(targethost contains "://", tostring(parse_url(targethost).host), targethost), tostring(parse_url(requesturl).host))))
| where huntdestinationhost in ("reallifeaccounting.com", "outagefixed.sbs", "outagerestored.sbs")
| project timegenerated, userid, sourceaddress, targetaddress, requesturl, proxyaction, huntdestinationhost
| order by timegenerated desc
 devicenetworkevents
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend huntdestinationhost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", coalesce(iff(remoteurl contains "://", tostring(parse_url(remoteurl).host), remoteurl), tostring(parse_url(remoteurl).host))))
| where huntdestinationhost in ("reallifeaccounting.com", "outagefixed.sbs", "outagerestored.sbs")
| project timestamp, devicename, remoteip, remoteurl, actiontype, huntdestinationhost
| order by timestamp desc
 commonsecuritylog
| where timegenerated > ago(7d)
| extend huntdestinationhost = tolower(trim_end(@"\.+", coalesce(iff(destinationhostname contains "://", tostring(parse_url(destinationhostname).host), destinationhostname), tostring(parse_url(requesturl).host))))
| where huntdestinationhost in ("reallifeaccounting.com", "outagefixed.sbs", "outagerestored.sbs")
| project timegenerated, sourceip, destinationip, requesturl, deviceaction, huntdestinationhost
| order by timegenerated desc
items.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Phishing Destinations
